title: A check holds the hooks to their Python 3.9 floor
why: README.md:206 and lint/ste_lint.py:8 set Python 3.9 as the hooks' floor, but all 18 CI jobs pin 3.11. A builder on #2331 used `glob.iglob(root_dir=...)` (3.10+); on 3.9 the guard crashes and fails open. Round 3 review caught it, not a check (lane notes-fix-large-1, 20:20 CST Nov 8).
note: Filed by triage, Nov 8 20:21 CST. Proposed check: a CI job on 3.9 for the hook suites, or a static floor check over hooks/ (vermin -t=3.9 or similar). Related: lane-lint-parses-at-ci-python (parse at the pinned version). The lane-inflow hold was lifted 20:28 CST Nov 8 (owner's 20:24 CST word).
